name: Temple Courtyard
desc:
The Temple Courtyard is a small courtyard that leads up to the [Temple of the Forgotten Flame](location:the_temple_of_the_forgotten_flame). It is located above [Path's Respite](location:paths_respite). The area is similar to that of ruins.

In order to open the door to the Temple Courtyard, a button must be pressed located in the center of the garden behind an archway.
